description: This file defines the ShareAccountReadPlatformService interface, which extends AccountReadPlatformService and declares methods for retrieving share account data, including templates, specific account details, response parameters, all share account data for dividends, and account numbers by ID.

classes.name: ShareAccountReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface for reading share account information, extending general account reading capabilities and adding share account-specific methods.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template of share account data based on client and product IDs.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific share account by its ID, with an option to include template details.

methods.name: getResponseDataParams
methods.description: Returns the set of response data parameters available for share accounts.

methods.name: retrieveAllShareAccountDataForDividends
methods.description: Retrieves all share account data related to dividends for a specific product, including whether to fetch inactive accounts and within a specified start date.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account number associated with a given account ID.
